title: Nvidia Boosts Share Buyback Authorization by $150 Billion
summary:
Matthew Bloxham, Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Media and Tech Analyst, joined Bloomberg's Paul Sweeney and Scarlet Fun to talk about the top tech stories of the day, including Nvidia's new systems and buybacks.
Nvidia Corp., the chip developer at the heart of the artificial intelligence boom, increased the size of its share buyback plan by $150 billion, increasing the total remaining amount authorized to $235 billion.
Nvidia will complete the buyback through fiscal 2028, the Santa Clara, California-based company said in a statement on Monday. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Iran Refuses to Soften Demands as Trump Rejects Hormuz Offer
summary:
Mike McGlone, Senior Commodity Strategist for Bloomberg Intelligence, joined Bloomberg's Paul Sweeney and Scarlet Fu to talk about the state of the oil and trade market as the US and Iran continue talks.
Iran and the US appeared far apart on a new ceasefire deal or the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, with Tehran saying it’s sticking to a proposal US President Donald Trump has rejected.
Tehran made an offer to reopen the strait within seven days if Washington makes some concessions, which it hasn’t specified. Its leaders have previously said the US must lift a naval blockade and oil sanctions for there to be any progress on allowing more ships through the vital waterway. (Source: Bloomberg)
